status: external inputs; fetched and hash-checked by fetch_inputs.py; ignored by Git
publication_note: Laboratory cross-sections and quantum yields as recommended by the NASA/JPL evaluation, retrieved from the MPI-Mainz UV/VIS Spectral Atlas (Keller-Rudek, Moortgat, Sander and Soerensen 2013, Earth Syst. Sci. Data 5, 365-373), which asks users to cite the atlas and the original measurements. The files are not redistributed by this repository. A hash mismatch means the upstream bytes changed and must be reviewed, never silently accepted.
